item.title: Control Plane Only Updates (OpenShift 4.16+)
item.description: Special handling for OpenShift 4.16+ control-plane-only updates that require CNV workload updates to be disabled. Background: What Changed in OpenShift 4.16 Starting with OpenShift 4.16: RHCOS upgraded to version 9.4 All virt-launcher pods must use the same RHCOS version During control-plane-only update, CNV workload updates are automatically disabled This prevents virt-launcher pods from updating before control plane is stable Control Plane Only Update Flow Standard OpenShift Upgrade Sequence OpenShift 4.15 → 4.16: 1. Control plane nodes upgrade (masters) - CNV workload updates DISABLED during this phase - Existing virt-launcher pods continue running - No VM migrations triggered by CNV 2. Control plane upgrade completes - All master nodes on RHCOS 9.4 - API server stable - etcd healthy 3. Re-enable CNV workload updates - Manual step required - Triggers virt-launcher pod updates 4. Wait for VM workloads to update - VMs live-migrated to new pods - All virt-launcher pods use RHCOS 9.4 5. Worker nodes upgrade - CNV handles VM migrations normally - workloadUpdateStrategy applies 6.
